integrity: The binary upper bound enumerates every pair of binary input-transition maps for each direction split and all relevant end-marker return behaviors after symmetry reduction. Direct independent replay checks the binary and ternary witnesses and all shorter words.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to four-state direction-determinate two-way deterministic finite automata. It determines the minimum alphabet size for attaining the published four-state extremum but does not solve the fixed-alphabet problem for larger state sets. The binary upper bound is exhaustive computational evidence over a superset of the actual automata.
title: A ternary alphabet is minimal for the four-state direction-determinate extremum
